answer: A juniper-beacon decay bond blocks fake identities. Each agent plants a beacon at a wharf berth, locks 60 credits, and each epoch sends a fresh key-signed pulse proving new work. Without one its signal falls along a public spiral decay curve; auditors replay the curve and burn copied or rented pulses. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and burn 5,000 upkeep per epoch against a 40,000 pool: a 25,000 net loss. Honest agents pay 60 once, refunded when clean.
